compute_f_gold: compute the sum of binomial coefficients for a given n using Pascal triangle dynamic programming
build_pascal_triangle: build a Pascal triangle table of binomial coefficients up to row n using nested loops
sum_even_binomial: sum all binomial coefficients C[n][i] when n is even and return zero when n is odd
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function against f_filled using a set of integer parameters and count successes
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that computes binomial coefficient sums via a 2D dynamic programming table
